root.name: English Opening: Neo-Catalan
root.moves: 1. Nf3 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. g3 d5

overview: White fianchettoes the king's bishop and Black takes the centre with ...d5, reaching a Catalan-like position without White's d-pawn on d4. After 4.Bg2 Be7 5.O-O O-O White plays d4 for a normal Catalan or keeps it flexible with Qc2 and Nc3; Black may also play ...c5 or ...dxc4. White presses on the long diagonal and the queenside; Black has a solid position.

white_ideas.idea: Fianchetto on g2, castle, and play d4 with long-diagonal pressure on d5 and b7.
Win back the c4 pawn after ...dxc4 with Qa4 or Ne5 and keep a small edge.

black_ideas.idea: Hold the centre with ...Be7, ...O-O, ...c6 or ...dxc4, and ...b6 ...Bb7 or ...c5.
Neutralise the g2 bishop and equalise in a solid structure.

typical_structures.structure: Catalan structure with White pawns on c4/d4 against Black's d5/e6 and the g2 bishop on the long diagonal.

character.notes: Slow, pressure-based play where Black's position is hard to break and White maintains a small edge.

gambit.notes: Any c4 pawn taken by ...dxc4 is regained.

structure.notes: Centre not yet resolved; d4 usually follows, then QGD-like tension.

approach.notes: A mainstream White set-up used by top players.

level.notes: Plans are positional and need understanding; limited memorisation.

sublines_that_differ.name: 4...c5
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. Nf3 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. g3 d5 4. Bg2 c5
sublines_that_differ.how: Black challenges the centre at once, leading to more open asymmetrical play.

character.reason: Catalan-style play in which Black's position is hard to break and White presses slowly.

gambit.reason: No material is given up for real.

structure.reason: Centre in tension with the d-pawn and c-pawn undecided, like the Catalan.

approach.reason: A mainstream English/Réti set-up, though it needs d5 from Black.

level.reason: Long-diagonal pressure plans need understanding but little theory.

plans.reason: White's g2 bishop on the long diagonal is the central idea.
